description_en: Retrieves the location information of a phone number based on the instance ID and phone number
description_zh: 根据实例ID、电话号码获取该号码的归属地信息
name: GetNumLocation

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. It is used to ensure idempotence and can be generated by using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can obtain instance ID from the Instance Management section in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The phone number to be queried
parameters.name: phone_num

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of Success indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Data.description_en: The location of the phone number

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
